title: The line bundle of an effective Cartier divisor commutes with flat pullback
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_S$ be an effective Cartier ideal [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal] (a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf which, on the members of some open cover of $S$, is generated by a single nonzerodivisor of the ring of sections) with closed subscheme $D=V(\mathcal I)\subset S$, and let $g:Y\to S$ be a flat morphism of schemes [def-weil-flat-morphism]; let $D_Y=D\times_SY$ be the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] with its projection $q:D_Y\to Y$, and let $\mathcal I_{D_Y}=\ker\bigl(\mathcal O_Y\to q_*\mathcal O_{D_Y}\bigr)\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ be the ideal sheaf of $q$. Then there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $$\mathcal{H}om_{\mathcal O_Y}(\mathcal I_{D_Y},\mathcal O_Y)\cong g^*\mathcal{H}om_{\mathcal O_S}(\mathcal I,\mathcal O_S),$$ where $g^*$ is the pullback of modules [def-pc-module-pullback].
